reviews.title: What a terrible app!
reviews.text: Trying to use this iPad app is a fool’s errand.  There is virtually no navigation capability and there is zero navigation guidance.  It’s obvious the “developers” were working with budget and/or schedule constraints…or they used a bad software tool to port the content from the web site.  This is 2026: we have painless dentistry, we’ve given up on leeches, and we know how to write a decent iOS app.  It’s past time for TrueFire to commit to a redesign and rewrite.

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text:
The app has good options to follow the teacher and play along, but it quite a few major flaws. 
1. It’s super annoying. Keeps nagging me to enable notifications, constantly pushes me to buy more content. I already have what I want. I don’t need to be upsold every second. 
2. There’s no option to slow down the music without losing the pitch. It just slows down the playback instead of intelligently changing the rhythm. Moises.AI does this very well for example. 
3. If the teacher gives an introduction, there’s no way to proceed to playing. I have to scroll there manually and then hope I do it precisely enough to have time to move my hand back to the position before the action starts.

reviews.title: Great courses, awful app
reviews.text: I’d buy more courses if they updated the glitchy app. Feels the same today as it did 5 years ago - and it wasn’t good then! The buttons aren’t very responsive, and sometimes totally non responsive. Freezes. Selecting portions of the song to loop is a chore. The list goes on and on. It’s an app I use a lot despite the experience. Would consider All Access with an overhaul.
